Reporting to the Chief People and Transformation Officer, the Manager P&C Operations will play a critical role in shaping and leading ACER's People & Culture service delivery model. As ACER continues to evolve, this newly defined position will centralise and strengthen the delivery of core people operations, ensuring services, systems and processes are scalable, compliant and customer focused across the employee lifecycle.

Leading a small team, you will help to clarify the P&C service propositions and SLAs, simplify, standardise and deliver core operational activities including employee lifecycle administration in areas including recruitment, onboarding, international mobility, learning administration and P&C reporting.  You will also take functional ownership of SuccessFactors, strengthen governance and service standards, lead process improvement initiatives and provide trusted workforce insights to support decision making across the organisation. This is a highly visible role that combines operational leadership with strategic improvement, enabling the broader People & Culture team to focus on partnering, capability and organisational development.

We are seeking an experienced People Operations, HR Operations or Shared Services leader who combines strong operational discipline with a continuous improvement mindset. You will bring demonstrated experience leading HR service delivery functions, managing systems and data, driving process simplification and automation and building high performing teams. Equally important is your ability to influence stakeholders, navigate complexity and create practical, scalable solutions that improve employee and manager experiences.

A relevant postgraduate qualification and extensive experience operating at a senior level within complex organisations will be highly regarded.
